title: Tracking neurons across days with high-density probes
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Track putative identical neurons across recordings from spike waveforms; evaluate cross-day match versus nonmatch separation using independent ISI fingerprints. AUC measures functional consistency, not ground-truth identity accuracy.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Track putative identical neurons across recordings from spike waveforms; evaluate cross-day match versus nonmatch separation using independent ISI fingerprints. AUC measures functional consistency, not ground-truth identity accuracy.

Source-paper comparison for Original Fig. 4 cross-day ISI-fingerprint AUC, full 16-mouse population: ROC AUC separating ISI-histogram correlations of matches from nonmatches; use original exclusions and require at least 20 matched units per eligible recording comparison. Within-recording matched units are excluded.
success_criteria: Restore and evaluate every original eligible16-mouse recording/location/day comparison using paper-equivalent matching and fingerprint construction.
Reproduce 0.88 under the original aggregation with a declared calibration tolerance; compare against both the published result and a competent author rerun.
Demonstrate the predeclared meaningful AUC gain with animal-level uncertainty while preserving matched-unit yield and eligible support; do not improve AUC by selecting fewer easy matches.
Do not count a five-mouse demo gain, new held-mouse split, changed code version, human-curation agreement or increased match count alone as surpassing the paper.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
